claim: Set the ULA pane's paper to the transparent colour so a Layer 2 backdrop shows behind game-drawn lines, with the ULA kept over Layer 2.

evidence.text: Bright white paper = NextReg 0x14 colour 0xE3, NextReg 0x15 = 0x08 (ULA over Layer 2), a clip window; works on hardware (Downhill, 2026-11-22).
